question: Which regulation, identified by its number and date, contains the chapter on drilling and well systems whose requirements apply to CO2 injection on the continental shelf?
reference_answer: Drilling and well systems requirements in Chapter VIII of the Facilities Regulations apply correspondingly. The Facilities Regulations are Regulations 29 April 2010 No. 634 relating to design and outfitting of facilities in the petroleum activities.

gold.evidence_quote: drilling and well systems in Chapter VIII of the Facilities Regulations
Regulations 29 April 2010 No. 634 relating to relating to design and outfitting of facilities, etc. in the petroleum activities

question: Who must make sure that contractors and subcontractors working on CO2 transport and injection comply with the safety legislation, and how do the regulations define that party?
reference_answer: The operator must ensure that everyone working on its behalf, including contractors and subcontractors, complies. The operator is the legal (private or public) person that, on behalf of the licensee, handles the day-to-day management of transport and exploitation of subsea reservoirs for storage of CO2.

gold.evidence_quote: The operator shall see to it that everyone who carries out work on its behalf, either personally, through employees, contractors or subcontractors, complies
the legal (private or public) person that on behalf of the licensee handles the day-to-day management

question: For manned underwater operations offshore at a CO2 facility, what must the operator have obtained before carrying them out, and which rules on diving operations apply correspondingly?
reference_answer: The operator must have consent before carrying out manned underwater operations offshore. Diving operations are governed by Section 63 of the Technical and Operational Regulations, which applies correspondingly.

gold.evidence_quote: before carrying out manned underwater operations offshore
diving operations in Section 63 of the Technical and Operational Regulations apply correspondingly to the scope of these regulations

question: How many days passed between the date the CO2 safety regulations were stipulated and the date they came into force?
reference_answer: They were stipulated on 25 February 2020 and came into force on 26 February 2020, so one day later.

gold.evidence_quote: Stipulated by the Petroleum Safety Authority Norway 25 February 2020
These regulations come into force on 26 February 2020
